nodes.text: In the name of the Father and of the
Son and of the Holy Spirit,
amen. Three good brothers were going
along a road; there they met our
Lord Jesus Christ, and he said,
“Where are you going, three good brothers?”
“Lord, we are going to a mountain
to look for a herb
of such power that it is good
for every kind of wound, whether it be struck
or stabbed, or from whatever cause it
be.” Then our Lord Jesus Christ said,
“Come to me, you three good
brothers, and swear to me by the
Crucified One and by the milk
of the maiden Saint Mary that you
will neither conceal it nor accept payment; and
go to Mount Olivet
and take oil of the olive tree, and
sheep's wool, and lay them on
the wound and speak thus:
‘The Jew Longinus, who pierced our Lord
Jesus Christ in the side with
the spear: that did not fester, nor
grow hot, nor ache, nor
bleed too much, nor rot.
So may this wound do: may it not bleed
too much, nor grow
hot, nor ache, nor fester,
nor rot, [this wound] that I have
blessed, in the name of the Father and
of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
amen.’” Say the blessing three times
and as many Our Fathers, and
do no more than as here
is written.
